title: Green-listing certain waste for the purposes of shipments to recovery between Member States

triage.reason: A Commission delegated regulation on green-listing certain waste for shipments to recovery under the Waste Shipment Regulation is in active preparation, with its public feedback period closing on 15 September 2026, a recent concrete step.

draft.summary: The feedback period for the initiative 'Green-listing certain waste for the purposes of shipments to recovery between Member States' closed on 15 September 2026.
draft.source_quote: frontEndStage: ISC_WORKFLOW; receivingFeedbackStatus: CLOSED; feedbackStartDate: 2026/08/18 15:16:00; feedbackEndDate: 2026/09/15 23:59:59

key_dates.text: Feedback period on the green-listing initiative opens.
Feedback period on the green-listing initiative closes.

draft.interpretation: If adopted, the delegated regulation may ease administrative requirements for intra-EU shipments of the listed waste to recovery, which could benefit recyclers and converters using such waste.
